name: kahea
description: Deterministic HTTP and WebSocket testing with policy-gated execution for AI agents.
long_description: Kāhea turns API descriptions, captured requests, workflows, and finite WebSocket sessions into sealed plans, invokes only with exact capability grants, and returns typed, replayable evidence.

tools.name: kahea_inspect
tools.description: Discover HTTP, workflow, and finite WebSocket operations without network access.

tools.name: kahea_plan
tools.description: Create an integrity-sealed request, workflow, conformance, or finite WebSocket plan.

tools.name: kahea_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a sealed plan with exact capability grants.

tools.name: kahea_explain
tools.description: Retrieve selected typed evidence from a local store.
